nodes.text: 1-China is once again at the center of a health concern,five years after the COVID-19 pandemic https://t.co/URSaDfWkUp media is abuzz with images and videos of crowded hospitals in northern China,where cases of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV),a respiratory illness,are on the rise.

nodes.author: Omar3_khanUSA
nodes.text: 2-HMPV isn’t new—it was first detected in 2001 and is found globally. However, the virus primarily targets children and adolescents, making this outbreak particularly concerning. While there’s no vaccine for HMPV yet, no emergency has been declared by the WHO or China’s CDC.
